reviewed_candidates.reason: Root-token authorization, lexical and realpath confinement, symlink-walk checks, O_NOFOLLOW, and post-open device/inode verification prevent file-content disclosure outside the authorized root.
Renderer IPC forwards only missionId, cwd, cols, and rows; internal shell, args, and env overrides are not exposed through the production bridge.
The PTY is an explicitly user-opened local shell, the sender is authorized, and inherited launch environment values are already available to that same local user.
All new privileged native-browser IPC handlers authorize the main renderer; child-view events are mapped back to an owned native browser session.
Inspection and design payloads remove script, style, and noscript text, redact sensitive fields and attributes, sanitize URL-bearing attributes, and bound returned text and HTML.
Diagnostic URLs and console messages redact credential-like values with bounded linear scanning, and network and console buffers are capped.
DOCX preview removes active elements, rejects unsafe CSS constructs, disables alt-chunk rendering, and sanitizes generated content before insertion.
Unsafe SVG/Mermaid rendering and legacy unguarded IPC channels predate this PR; the PR does not introduce or weaken those paths.
Local file navigation and a shared persistent browser partition are documented product trade-offs that predate the scanned change set.
